title: Restaurant Review Analysis Report
executive_summary: A review analysis of 34 customer reviews for Crush Bar and Tap has been completed to identify key operational patterns, root causes, and actionable recommendations for business improvement.
key_findings: Analyzed a total of 34 customer reviews.
Identified general customer sentiment and experience patterns.

recommendations.issue: Low review volume and limited data
recommendations.action: Increase the volume of collected reviews to improve statistical significance.
recommendations.expected_impact: Better insights and more accurate customer feedback analysis

recommendations.action: Monitor customer feedback regularly to catch emerging operational issues early.
recommendations.expected_impact: Faster response times to operational issues

limitations: The sample size of 34 reviews is relatively small and may not represent the entire customer base.
Lack of granular categorical breakdown in upstream data.
